summary: Serge Rielau proposes a new SQL data type, OBJECT, that matches structured fields by name rather than position, addressing the current limitations of STRUCT. The Spark community is planning its inaugural sync on Nov 30, 2026, with a 50‑minute agenda covering recent changes, SPIP updates, release status, and an open floor. It defines five security guarantees (G1‑G5) covering leaks, writes, and metadata, and adds a capability signal to make older Spark releases fail closed for restricted callers. The discussion asks whether Spark Connect Gateway, which includes cryptographic libraries in its container image, must undergo the ASF export process before its 0.1.0 release.
